name: Tabs
description: Switch between panels with a water underline or a pill that slides to the current tab.

props.name: variant
props.description: Underline: tabs on a hairline with a 2px water line under the current one. Pill: a card that slides inside a muted track.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Lay the tabs out in a row above the panel, or in a column beside it.

props.name: selectedKey
props.description: The id of the current tab (controlled).

props.name: defaultSelectedKey
props.description: The id of the tab shown first (uncontrolled). Defaults to the first tab.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called when another tab is chosen.

props.name: keyboardActivation
props.description: Whether arrow keys switch panels straight away, or only move focus until Enter or Space.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Tabs.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the set of tabs for assistive technology.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components TabList.

props.name: id
props.description: Matches the id of the TabPanel this tab shows.

props.name: children
props.description: The label, optionally with a lucide icon before it.

props.name: count
props.description: A number in a small muted badge after the label.

props.name: id
props.description: Matches the id of its Tab.

props.name: children
props.description: The panel content. It fades in when its tab is chosen.

props.name: shouldForceMount
props.description: Keep the panel in the DOM while it is hidden.
